purpose: licensed agent-domain mixture for a Jev-like advisory decision scorer; not Jev parity or execution authority
method_sources: Open-Jev recipe: candidate-conditioned scalar head, Yes-minus-No init, soft CE + 0.1 Brier, LoRA 2e-5 / head 5e-5, held-out temperature
Open-Jev community controls: one-fact counterfactual minimal pairs kept inside one group
StruQ / SecAlign / Meta SecAlign: untrusted-content instructions never authorize actions; benign user-requested controls prevent over-defense
Soft ordinal labels (SORD-style) plus ranked-probability loss for score decisions
Per-kind temperature calibration to address Noul collapse

excluded: rows failing the per-row CC0 or typesafe.ai source filter

promotion_gates.G5_general_regression: release-v2 test top1 >= 0.42 and held-source OOD top1 >= 0.63 (clean-2B results minus 5 points)

promotion_meaning: Passing every gate permits enabling the scorer as an opt-in advisory typed_decision engine. It never grants execution authority, and inspected authored cases cannot establish Jev parity.
reported_not_gated: 12 previously inspected typed_desktop_transfer cases against cached Jev references
per-source and per-kind NLL, Brier and selective-prediction metrics
